peak_estimate.source: Every public producer declares estimatedBytes before startManagedRun creates its run directory.

budget.maximum_managed_bytes_source: PUPPETLOOM_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES or the 2 GiB project default
budget.minimum_free_bytes_source: PUPPETLOOM_ARTIFACT_MIN_FREE_BYTES or the 2 GiB project default

reuse.reason: Each run is a distinct observable evidence result; repeatable PSD inputs are read from the single tracked test/fixtures source instead of being downloaded or regenerated per run.

lifecycle.preflight: Measure managed bytes and filesystem free space before creating the run directory or any payload.
lifecycle.finalization: Rewrite run.json with succeeded or failed status, reuse decision, class byte totals, the conservative peak bound, complete file inventory, byte counts, and SHA-256 hashes.
lifecycle.interruption: A later run marks ownerless pending manifests interrupted, inventories every payload, and preserves report-only cleanup candidates.

root_source.value: runtimeLogPath project reports or Electron userData

peak_estimate.source: 5 MiB active segments with a 64 MiB aggregate default cap

budget.maximum_managed_bytes_source: PUPPETLOOM_RUNTIME_LOG_MAX_BYTES or the 64 MiB desktop default
budget.minimum_free_bytes_source: Incremental JSONL records remain below the active segment cap

reuse.reason: Runtime log records describe one concrete process and event sequence and cannot be reused as evidence for another run.

lifecycle.preflight: Write runtime-log-policy.json and measure aggregate owned logs before each append.
lifecycle.finalization: Rotate the active log by move when it reaches 5 MiB; never overwrite an archived segment.
lifecycle.interruption: JSONL records are append-complete per event; existing segments remain inspectable after process exit.
